comment: I passed by BKC this morning and this dump has grown significantly over the weekend. Toxic smell is reaching the main road.
Municipal Solid Waste team has dispatched 4 dump trucks. Debris removal in progress. Site will be fully cleared within 24 hours.
I have geotagged photographs showing the tree contractor vehicle license plate. Uploading to support municipal action.
Pollution control board water chemistry testing kit dispatched. Discharge pipe location mapped.
